name: seedream-mcp
description: Independent MCP adapter for Seedream, Seedance and MediaKit video enhancement.

interface.shortDescription: Images, videos and standard/generative video super-resolution.
interface.longDescription: Unofficial MCP wrapper for official Volcengine APIs. Seedream images, Seedance 2.0 standard/fast/mini and 2.5 videos, plus MediaKit standard/generative enhancement. Bundled reference-video Skill coordinates replaceable preprocessing plugins, model-aware FFmpeg cuts and COS uploads. Separate MediaKit credentials. No automatic paid retries or model fallback.
defaultPrompt: Check Seedream, Seedance and MediaKit capabilities and configuration.
Plan a reference video with $reference-video-production before authorized generation.
Preview the image, video or enhancement request before submitting it.
